cd.title: Lose Yourself
cd.situation: Battle night outside the shop. Mira has one shot at the mic with her acoustic 'Lose Yourself', but the crowd is glued to their phones and she has frozen.
cd.today: Mira's 'Lose Yourself' went gold. She still opens the shop's battle night every December.

actions.label: picked up Mira's dropped CD-R
actions.line: A scratched CD-R on the bench: 'MIRA - LOSE YOURSELF (one take)', in silver marker. She must have dropped it.

actions.label: played it at the shop's listening post
actions.prompt: Play it at the listening post
actions.line: The owner turns the listening post right up. Phones go down. 'Who IS this?' Mira stops shaking, grabs the mic and doesn't miss her one shot.
actions.lockedLine: The listening post is free, but you've got nothing worth playing. Didn't someone drop a CD by the bench?

offline.headline: The Battle Night Nobody Was Watching
offline.article: On 13 December 2002 a stranger played Mira's dropped CD-R of 'Lose Yourself' at Hollow Records' listening post, and a crowd glued to their phones turned round to listen. She took her one shot. Her version has just gone gold, and its disc hangs by the shop door.
